Knowledge management practices are standardised and integrated into daily operations through a knowledge sharing culture, including KM process performance measures, KM competencies and capturing lessons learned to enable the organization optimize the standard processes and approaches to “fit” business needs.

Proactive maintenance workflow involves continuous detection, diagnostic, and prognostic algorithms to forecast AO faults before they occur. Static rules or conditions of AO to support critical decision-making processes are used. The condition based Maintenance applies automation in monitoring of AO components, forecasting, and corrective action.

AO maintenance  requests are processed through a single point of contact.

Standardized technology tools are used. Maintenance Requests are registered, categorized, and prioritized, following a versioning control of approved application modifications.

AO decommissioning process mitigates security risks that may arise as software assets/components approach their end-of-life. Proactive engagement with stakeholders including the customers and user groups to prevent disruption of service or support is used. Technology tools manage the decommissioning process within functions.
column9:
AO performance is measured at all stages of its lifecycle and provides closed-loop feedback to systems and users (engineers, developers, data scientists, etc.).

The real life performance of the AO initiative is measured. If a degradation of performances is noted, models are re-trained, and deployed automatically if they perform better than the former ones. AO performance teams are adequately skilled, trained, and rightsized to manage the massive deployment of AI components in Production.

Knowledge Management is based on best practices. The change management strategy, refines  KM practices and processes into standard, replicable methodologies across the organization. The organization is actively learning and institutionalizing functional experience to continuously optimize most digital knowledge management processes and workflows.

Predictive maintenance workflow combines automated data collection,  analytics and machine learning algorithms

A 'digital twin' is used to monitor the performance of AO. AO maintenance teams are enabled to to address potential issues before they become critical.

There is an MR repository for registering and tracking of AO process failures and user requests.

Proactive communications report failures and planned preventive maintenance activities that impact various functions in the organization.

MR management is continuously optimized within the organization.

There is full visibility into lifecycle of all SW and HW assets through the integration of decommissioning into overall asset management plans. There is regular performance reporting, evaluation of the lifecycle state of every software asset component, and estimate their end-of-life.
column11:
Performance metrics are monitored continuously to ensure quality of service and identify potential performance degradation due to data or concept drift.

Performance auditing process is in place to assess solidity and robustness of the AO Performance Management process, current and expected performance of relevant AO components, systems, and services in Production, integrity and proper use of data, current issues and risks, compliance with given quality/legal/regulatory/security/ethical policies/rules/standards, end-user and stakeholder satisfaction, organizational and skills gaps.

There is a Knowledge Center of Excellence including methodologies that are institutionalized to support the business strategy and business model in order to achieve desired business outcomes and breakthrough innovation.

Prescriptive maintenance workflow involves the use of continuous streams of data from AO assets with data analytics and artificial intelligence/machine learning to predict failure events, recommend actions and intelligently schedule service maintenance to reduce operational risks.

MRs management is continuously optimized across the organization's ecosystem with the AO management process linked to the maintenance improvement process. MR repository is operational and used for registering and tracking of failures and user requests within the organization and its ecosystem partners.

Maintenance process performance are measured and documented, with details on the usage and the costs for all maintenance services.

Standardized management reports for maintenance service request are made available to relevant stakeholders in the organization.

The organization continuously reviews and optimizes the decommissioning process, to reflect lessons learned. There is a well established AO support plan with clear timelines for ending support on prior versions, and proactively engage with stakeholders across organization and ecosystem partners including customers to prevent disruption of AO service or support.
